kab0: Who needs to take extra care?
kab1: According to systematic reviews of chest wall injuries, being 65 or older, breaking three or more ribs and having an existing condition, especially heart or lung disease, roughly double the risk of serious outcomes; pneumonia developing later also raises the risk markedly. If you are in one of these groups, you can agree a follow-up plan with your doctor, and seek help without delay if you develop a fever, coloured phlegm or increasing breathlessness.
